collection: Each workload/profile has a fresh child, three requests and stable request-ID lengths. Loading/build/resolution use inherited limits; null shared work is not zero cost. Stages are marginal request work; terminal reservation is separate. RSS peak is process lifetime high-water, heap/RSS snapshots are observed and not allocations; retained census is a proxy. Wall time includes OS/JIT/GC noise. Structural candidates certify no schema validity; finite checks certify only supplied evidence.
summary: Samples are summarized from the hashed raw reports. Full stage wall and before/after RSS/heap telemetry remains in those reports. Stage costs are [marginal work, marginal nodes]. Samples are ordered cold, warm, warm. Heap maxima preserve the post-stage observation series; they are not allocation totals or guaranteed peaks.

largerRealTier.reason: No larger redistributable service snapshot with complete closure is present in this repository at the baseline. Weather (21,204 source bytes) is its largest WSDL. Synthetic scale is not larger-real-service evidence.
